hypotheses.storyTitle: Review Statement Credit and Holiday Goal Progress
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Daniel reviews his 7,300 coin balance and applies statement credits toward his active Holiday Spending Money goal.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Daniel visits the rewards overview to check his accumulated balance and monitor his holiday savings.
hypotheses.storyTension: Ensuring transparent cash value translation without unnecessary gamification or irrelevant partner vouchers.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Clear visibility of statement credit options and direct progress tracking toward bill reduction.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Seamless review and application of statement credits to reduce monthly card bills.

hypotheses.storyTitle: Tangible Value and Bill Reduction Analysis
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Daniel inspects his cash-equivalent earnings to plan his next automatic payment reward allocation.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer wants to understand the exact monetary value of accumulated points for upcoming bill reductions.
hypotheses.storyTension: Need for predictable, guaranteed reward rates and transparent calculations.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Clear tangible value breakdown confirming exact bill savings.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Transparent value calculation and redemption readiness.
